title: Complete your order
description: Review the package, enter your in-game account details, then pay from your wallet balance.
giftDescription: This is a gift order — nothing is debited from any wallet; it is recorded as a paid invoice with the store's other invoices.
offerPromise: Pay from your wallet balance and we deliver straight to your game account.

summary.title: Order summary
summary.totalHint: The final amount is calculated on the server the moment you confirm.
summary.giftNote: Gift order: recorded as a paid invoice, no wallet balance involved.
summary.insufficientDescription: You need {amount} more to place this order. Add balance, then try again.
summary.trustInstant: Delivered to your order page within seconds of confirming.
summary.trustSecure: Paid from your store wallet — your card details are never shared with anyone.

fields.title: Your in-game account details
fields.description: These are the details the supplier uses to deliver. Check every character: they cannot be changed once the order is placed, and anything delivered to the wrong account cannot be recovered.
fields.noFieldsTitle: This package needs no extra details
fields.noFieldsDescription: Place the order and your code appears on the order page once it is delivered.
fields.lockedNotice: On confirmation the amount leaves your wallet and these details are sent to the supplier as they are.
fields.giftNotice: This is a gift order: it is recorded as a paid invoice and these details are sent to the supplier as they are.
fields.giftRecipientLabel: Gift to a customer — their email
fields.giftRecipientHint: Enter the customer's email, then press “Fill details” to auto-fill their account details if they have bought this package before.
fields.giftPrefillDone: Details filled automatically. Review them before confirming the order.

giftRecipientErrors.not_found: No customer uses that email address.
giftRecipientErrors.not_eligible: This customer has not bought this package before, so there is nothing to fill.
giftRecipientErrors.unknown: Could not auto-fill. Please try again.

errors.unauthenticated: Your session expired. Sign in and try again.
errors.suspended: This account is suspended and cannot place orders. Please contact support.
errors.unavailable: This package is no longer available. Browse the other packages we have.
errors.insufficient_balance: Your wallet balance does not cover this order. Add balance, then try again.
errors.supplier_unavailable: This offer is temporarily unavailable while the supplier is being checked. Please try again later.
errors.out_of_stock: The supplier is out of stock for this offer, so nothing was taken from your balance. Check back soon or pick another offer.
errors.in_progress: An order with these same details is already being placed. Check My orders before trying again.
errors.invalid_fields: Check the required account details, then try again.
errors.unknown: We could not place this order. Try again, and contact support if it keeps happening.
errors.coupon_not_found: We do not recognise that code. Check the spelling and try again.
errors.coupon_not_started: That code is not active yet.
errors.coupon_usage_limit: That code has reached its limit.
errors.coupon_already_used: You have already used that code.
errors.coupon_below_minimum: That code needs a larger order.
errors.coupon_wrong_scope: That code does not apply to this item.
errors.coupon_no_discount: That code gives no discount on this order.
errors.coupon_below_cost: That code cannot be used on this item — the discount would take it below what we pay for it. Our margin is small and we will not sell at a loss.

orders.title: My orders
orders.description: Every order with its status, amount, and delivery details.
orders.emptyDescription: Start from the games catalog and pick your first package.

orderDetail.title: Order details
orderDetail.accountDescription: These were sent to the supplier exactly as they are.
orderDetail.noAccountFields: This package needed no extra details.
orderDetail.codesDescription: Keep these somewhere safe; they stay available on this page.
orderDetail.pendingDescription: We have your order and delivery starts shortly. Refresh to follow the status.
orderDetail.processingDescription: The supplier is working on this order and it can take a few minutes. This page checks automatically for the result.
orderDetail.queuedTitle: Your order is confirmed and queued
orderDetail.queuedDescription: We have your payment and your order is in the delivery queue. It will be delivered shortly and you do not need to do anything. If you need help, support is available with your order number.
orderDetail.completedDescription: This order reached your account. If you cannot find it, contact support with the order number.
orderDetail.failedTitle: This order could not be delivered
orderDetail.failedDescription: The supplier could not complete this order.
orderDetail.refundedDescription: Delivery failed, so the full amount went back to your wallet balance. You will find it in your wallet history.
orderDetail.failedNotRefundedDescription: Delivery failed and the amount has not been returned automatically yet. Contact support with the order number and we will settle it.

review.title: How did it go?
review.description: Your review helps other customers decide. We publish it once we have read it.
review.nameHint: This appears with your review on the storefront.
review.thanks: Thank you. We will publish it once we have read it.

errors.invalid_input: Please give a rating and write a few words.
errors.not_eligible: Only a delivered order can be reviewed.
errors.already_reviewed: You have already reviewed this order.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Nothing was sent — please try again.

invoice.title: Invoice
invoice.footerNote: This invoice records the purchase as it stood when it was issued.
invoice.codesDescription: Keep these somewhere safe; they stay available on this page.
invoice.keepForSupportNote: Keep this invoice if you ever need to contact support about this order.

coupon.title: Discount code
coupon.description: Have a code? Enter it and we will show the discount on this order.
coupon.applied: Code applied. The discount below was calculated on the server and is confirmed when the order is placed.
